name: Diamic Days
original_name: ダイヤミック・デイズ
source:
For Rei, his second year at school has started of pretty normally, however, one day he sees on a notice board that a new school has opened and that everyone has to move there. Rei thinks that this will be a bit of a waste of effort but decides to go anyways. This new school is unusual in the fact that it allows students to make many of the decisions in the school – effectively they get to control their own school life. The protagonist decides that he’s going to try his best for the school. What will happen to him now?

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's Blog[/url]]
translation:
對憐而言，升入二年級後本來一切正常。但一天，他在公佈欄看到新學校開辦的消息，而且所有人都必須轉學。憐覺得這有些勞民傷財，卻還是決定前去。新學校的特殊之處在於，學生可以參與許多校務決定，實際上能決定自己想過什麼樣的校園生活。主角決定為學校盡力而為。接下來會發生什麼？

[改編自[url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's Blog[/url]]
